9083.question_text: If 5, 8, 6 and 2 occur with frequencies 3, 2, 4 and 1 respectively. Find the product of the modal and the median number
9083.explanation:
Arrange in ascending order
2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6, 6, 8, 8
Position of median = N/2 = 10/2 = 5th and 6th
∴Median = (6+6) / 2 = 12/2 = 6
Mode the item that repeats itself most = 6
∴Product of modal and median number = 6 x 6 = 36

= 17/30

9223.subject: Mathematics
9223.question_text: Find the value of x for which the function f(x) = 2x\(^3\) - x\(^2\) - 4x + 4 has a maximum value
9223.explanation:
f(x) = 2x\(^3\) - x\(^2\) - 4x – 4
f’(x) = 6x\(^2\) - 2x – 4
As f’(x) = 0
Implies 6x\(^2\) - 2x – 4 = 0
3x – x – 2 = 0 (By dividing by 2)
(3x + 2)(x - 1) = 0
3x + 2 = 0 implies x = \(\frac{-2}{3}\)
Or x - 1 = 0 implies x = 1
f’(x) = 6x\(^2\) - 2x – 4
f’’(x) = 12x – 2
At max point f’’(x) < 0
∴f’’(x) = 12x – 2 at x = 1
= 12(1) – 2
= 12 – 2 = 10
∴ Max at x = \(\frac{-2}{3}\)
